clue.text: The head of Cameron Diaz is swirling, filled with love signs

indicators.note: the shuffled letters are filled, taking the next piece into their middle

parts.note: love is nil in tennis scoring, which looks like the letter O

explanation.definitionFit: The twelve star signs of astrology together make up the circle of the heavens of that name.
